R7AB-bear-walk-0003.name: By Kersley Creek
R7AB-bear-walk-0003.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2008 (18 years old), 170 m SE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2023 (fire C11458), 180 m S: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Kersley Creek 40 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
